title: Christian Cross Totem
description:
This project changes totems into christian crosses
hope you like it
body:
Hey! I made this resource pack for myself but my friends told me to publish it sooo here I am

its a simple texture pack that changes the Totem of Undying into a cross
Dont expect much, its a small visual edit.

No hate or message behind it, just a lil change. If you like it, feel free to download it. if not, thats totally fine too.

Thanks for checking my page out!


if there are any issues please contact @LunarTN on discord

and this should work no matter the version![The Christian Cross Totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e129f55ab7f0e5e855ed5b40d2072e3da352cdd7.png)
